title: Indonesia apologizes to Malaysia, Singapore over wildfire haze
summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has apologized to Malaysia and Singapore over a toxic haze caused by rampant wildfires in his country that polluted the skies of Indonesia's neighbors.
